verdicts.reason: The two are nearly identical. Both move the small 'OBSIDIAN ONE' label below the body copy and blow it up into a loud second headline, which breaks the reading order and the hierarchy. Both also right-align the logo against left-aligned text, jam the body copy under the headline, and let the dark card cover almost all of the city skyline, so the key imagery is mostly lost. A's slightly larger headphones fill the middle better than B's smaller ones, which leave a looser gap above the CTA.
